notes.title: [UPDATE] v3.0.8
notes.content:
Hi everyone! How are you today?

BIOSZARD Corporation got a new update, check it out:

-=-=-=-=-=-
v3.0.8
-=-=-=-=-=-

[list]
[*][b] [Gameplay][/b] Doors now shows how many computer activations are needed to open it.
[*][b] [Gameplay][/b] Minimap is now available.
[*][b] [Gameplay][/b] Score system is now available.
[*][b] [Playable Character][/b] Satan now have Fire Breath instead of Stamina. (beat the game with Donald, Gadget or DocSkull to unlock it)
[*] [b][Cosmetics][/b] Sprite sorting order reworked.
[*] [b][Level Design][/b] Some laser traps added to Final Boss level.
[*][b] [Music] [/b]Sound Track changed in some levels.
[*][b] [Bug][/b] Fixed a bug that player could not unlock achievements from elevator levels.
[*][b] [Bug][/b] Fixed a bug that Easy Mode selection could not be undone.
[/list]

-=-=-=-=-=-

Please, report ANY bug you may find.

tags.feature: - Doors now shows how many computer activations are needed to open it.
- Satan now have Fire Breath instead of Stamina. (beat the game with Donald, Gadget or DocSkull to unlock it)
- Some laser traps added to Final Boss level.
- Sound Track changed in some levels.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug that player could not unlock achievements from elevator levels.
- Fixed a bug that Easy Mode selection could not be undone.

notes.title: [UPDATE] v3.0.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone! How are you today?

BIOSZARD Corporation got a new update, check it out:

-=-=-=-=-=-
v3.0.6
-=-=-=-=-=-

[b]CRITICAL Bug fixed: [/b]depending on character choose player got stuck on elevator 1 forever.
[b]CRITICAL Bug fixed:[/b] a troll Spitter Zombie was spawning behind walls on level 2-1 (Labs1), making it very difficult to spot and kill.
[b]Bug fixed: [/b]Toxic Zombie carcass with very low resolution, with some blur on it sprite.

This is all for now. 

-=-=-=-=-=-

I'm planning to implement some major changes in the next few days:
[list]
[*] Add a minimap
[*] Add fire breath to Satan unlockable character
[/list]

Please, report ANY bug you may found.
